0.8.0.intro: The store is here: every Steam game that has an Android version, with its price, its price history and a verdict.

0.8.1.intro: A small release: a fix for the controller mapping, and demos, betas and applications in the store.

0.8.2.intro: Free games and demos can now be added to the library from the store, the store has more filters, and the games that cannot run are marked online.

0.9.0.intro: Online play works: a game that signs in through Steam can log in to its own online services, and lobbies work in the games tested. Plus a real download progress with a time left, passthrough and VR choices for each game, and a smoother picture for games that stuttered.

0.9.1.intro: Online play works: a game that signs in through Steam can log in to its own online services, and lobbies work in the games tested. Plus a real download progress with a time left, passthrough and VR choices for each game, a report that says what goes wrong, and a game that was just updated no longer asks for the same update.

0.9.2.intro: The Steam Workshop of a game opens inside GamePort, already signed in, and the page of every game is redone: its pictures and trailer, its actions in one menu with a link to its store page, a bell for what wants a look, and an install that shows its steps and extra content. The store lists the extra content of a game. A game can follow an update channel of Steam, the library updates itself while GamePort is open, and saves can be shared with the PC. Plus a better Pico, a store filter for games not tested yet, a setting that frees memory before a game, and a problem report that says more.
